public_rationale: The 2016 account supports a real concern about knowingly leaving a misconception uncorrected. Reporting also confirms Murati's non-answer. limitations: The original Sora interview page was inaccessible; its contents are represented through contemporaneous reporting.

Counting all intentional non-disclosure as evasion would materially change the assessment.
